subject: Post-call: Align on demo timing, stakeholder routing, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@ecahealth.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@datagrove.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next-step demo windows

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand the ECA Health ingestion flows and the compliance constraints for PHI-adjacent telemetry. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary (2 bullets):
- Primary use case: embedded summarization + redaction for operational notes; target latency targets ~200–400ms per request for the clinic UI.
- Must satisfy on-prem data routing for audit logs and a SCIM-based SSO integration for internal users.

Next steps I recommend:
1) 45-min technical demo (live environment, KV-cache behavior, and SSO flow) with platform + security present.
2) Share a short mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement can see milestones and required artifacts.
3) Capture evidence owners for SOC2/retention questions.

Proposed demo windows (all times PT):
- Tue 9/7 10:00–10:45
- Wed 9/8 13:00–13:45
- Thu 9/9 08:30–09:15

Can you confirm which slot works and who from security/procurement should join? If it's helpful, I can loop in our security lead and solutions engineer — Marissa Cole (she's cc'd on the follow-up) will own the SSO/evidence discussion.

Attachments: redwood-mvp-demo-agenda.pdf (outline)

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129

Thanks Rishi — great call.

We'd like the demo to focus on two things: SSO flows and how you handle prefix caching for streaming summaries (we saw latency numbers, want to validate in a live run).

The best times for our team: Wed 9/8 13:00 PT works for us.

Please include a security contact; I'll bring our security engineering manager, Ben Turner (cc'd). Procurement will not need to attend the first demo but will want the MAP after the demo.

Also — can you confirm what artifacts you can share ahead of time (SOC2 scope, retention policy, logs)? If you have a short checklist for SSO requirements, that would help prep.

Alicia Gomez

What I'll cover (15–20 mins):
- SCIM provisioning flow and minimal attributes we require
- OIDC SSO flow demo (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated)
- Audit log export options and retention settings

Prep items for ECA (small ask):

- If procurement wants an accelerated MAP, tell Naomi and she'll share a one-pager after the demo.

Attachments: sso-checklist.xlsx (fields we ask to confirm), redwood-mvp-demo-agenda.pdf (same agenda, updated with times).

A quick proposed run: 00–05 min: introductions and success criteria
05–25 min: live demo (SSO + streaming latency with a sample record)
25–35 min: evidence + audit log Q&A
35–45 min: next steps and MAP owners

If you'd like, I can also bring a diagram of the on-prem routing options (we can attach that before the call).

See you Wednesday —
